description: This file contains test functions for PostgreSQL storage implementation in the control-plane component of a software project. It tests database connection pooling, database creation, connection settings, and concurrent operations on PostgreSQL.

methods.name: TestPostgresStorage_ConnectionPooling
methods.description: Tests the PostgreSQL connection pooling by initializing storage, creating and retrieving a record.

methods.name: TestPostgresStorage_DatabaseCreation
methods.description: Checks if database creation is handled, currently skipped because it requires admin access.

methods.name: TestPostgresStorage_ConnectionSettings
methods.description: Verifies that connection pool settings work correctly by initializing storage and creating a record.

methods.name: TestPostgresStorage_ConcurrentOperations
methods.description: Tests concurrent creation of execution records to ensure thread-safety and performance.
